svg.title: Princeton scout reference: all current conditions unknown
svg.desc: Four selected archived crossings and six sidewalk paths, with ten ramp endpoints and grouped anchors for fourteen checklist stops. PRN-01, PRN-10, PRN-11 and PRN-12 remain unlocated; no entrance or campus connection is inferred. See the companion notes for the full stop key.
